family: Standard AASHTO I-Girders as used for Philippine prestressed concrete deck-girder bridges (PSCG), metric callouts

source.title: Types of Bridges (Philippines) — Deck Girder Bridges — Prestressed Concrete Girders (PSCG) — Standard AASHTO I-Girders
source.form: single presentation slide (raster PNG, 2000 x 1500 px), supplied by the repository owner
source.origin_note: Owner found the slide; author, presentation, date and URL are unrecorded (unverified). Treated as a secondary presentation of DPWH practice, not a DPWH standard drawing.
source.locator: single image; five dimensioned outlines left to right labelled TYPE I, TYPE II, TYPE III, TYPE IV, TYPE V
source.source_status: secondary presentation slide (origin unrecorded); DPWH practice

field_meaning.chain_as_drawn: vertical dimension chain top to soffit, exactly as printed on the slide
field_meaning.top_fillet_width: horizontal callout of the inner flange-to-web fillet (TYPE V only)

I.notes: Chain closes (102+76+279+127+127 = 711). Horizontal taper extents derive from widths: (305-152)/2 = 76.5 top, (406-152)/2 = 127 bottom. One '127' label is printed below the soffit line; it belongs to the lowest chain interval.

II.notes: Chain sums to 913, 1 mm short of the 914 overall callout (independent rounding of 6/3/15/6/6 in). Convention: overall depth and flange/taper callouts govern; web height taken as 914 - 152 - 76 - 152 - 152 = 382.

III.notes: Chain sums to 1144, 1 mm over the 1143 overall callout (190.5 rounded up to 191). Convention: web height = 1143 - 178 - 114 - 191 - 178 = 482.

IV.notes: Chain sums to 1371, 1 mm short of the 1372 overall callout. Convention: web height = 1372 - 203 - 152 - 229 - 203 = 585.

V-as-drawn.notes: Chain closes (127+76+102+1067+254+203 = 1829). Outer top taper horizontal extent derived: (1067-203)/2 - 102 = 330. LABEL CONFLICT: the slide labels this outline 'TYPE V', but its depth and entire top/web geometry equal AASHTO/PCI Type VI (72 in: D1 72, D2 5, D3 3, D4 4, D5 10, D6 8; B1 42, B3 8, B4 4 in), not Type V (63 in = 1600 mm deep). BOTTOM-FLANGE CONFLICT: the slide prints bottom width 660 mm (26 in, the Type IV value); PCI Types V and VI have B2 = 28 in = 711 mm. Implemented as printed (660), which makes the bottom taper 228.5 wide over 254 high instead of 45 degrees. Whether 660 is a slide error or a DPWH variant is unresolved; the DPWH Odiongan Bridge 2 Type VI drawing (PDS 26/43) is the check. The slide label is kept as size 'V-as-drawn'.

comparison_vs_pci_2011.reference: bridgebeams.us.AashtoIBeamSection (PCI BDM Appendix B-7, Nov 2011, inch dimensions x 25.4)
comparison_vs_pci_2011.metric: max_vertex_mm = largest distance from a PH vertex to the nearest US vertex; hausdorff_mm = outline Hausdorff distance; sym_diff_mm2 = symmetric-difference area; area/ixx ratios PH/US (gross, about centroid)

V-as-drawn.note: All vertices within 0.5 mm of Type VI except the two bottom-flange corners (660 vs 711.2 mm width: 25.6 mm per side).

V-as-drawn_vs_US_V.note: depth 1829 vs 1600.2 mm; not a rounding difference

geometry_notes: Gross concrete outline only; strands, end blocks and deck excluded.
Origin at mid-soffit, y upwards, mm; symmetric about x = 0.
Types I-IV: 45-degree flange tapers implied by drawing; horizontal extents from width differences (not separately dimensioned).
Types II, III, IV: vertical chain does not close by 1 mm; overall depth governs and the web segment absorbs the residual (provenance transcribed-with-convention).

V-as-drawn: two-stage top transition (76 outer taper + 102 x 102 fillet); outer taper horizontal = 330 derived from widths. Bottom width 660 as printed (PCI Type VI: 711.2); bottom taper therefore 228.5 wide x 254 high.

The slide publishes no section properties; published-property residuals are not available. Types I-IV agree with PCI Types I-IV within inch-to-mm rounding (max vertex 1.0 mm, area within 0.25 %). V-as-drawn agrees with PCI Type VI except the bottom flange width.
